description: The Cousins (Kron-Cousins) R and I bands of the VRI system used for southern standard stars, as distributed by the GCPD.
facility_description: The General Catalogue of Photometric Data (GCPD, Mermilliod, Hauck & Mermilliod; now hosted at Masaryk University, Brno) compiles stellar photometry in more than 80 photometric systems together with system descriptions and filter transmission curves.
notes: NJM's curves for this instrument were taken from the SVO Filter Profile Service (GCPD group). Band Description values are copied verbatim from SVO VOTables, cited via Wayback Machine captures because svo2.cab.inta-csic.es timed out all session; the SVO acknowledgement already on NJM was not re-verified. Bands without the _ADPS suffix whose SVO ProfileReference is arXiv:1412.1474 are the Mann & von Braun (2015) revisions of the GCPD curves; _ADPS bands are the Asiago Database on Photometric Systems versions (Moro & Munari 2000; Fiorucci & Munari 2003), for which SVO's ProfileReference is the GCPD system page. Licence: GCPD publishes no explicit redistribution licence, only a citation request; classed 'attribution' on that basis. GCPD's basic reference is Cousins A.W.J. 1976, Mem. R. Astr. Soc. 81, 25; the bibcode guess 1976MmRAS..81...25C failed check_refs, so it is not listed. Curves adapted from MNASSA 33, 15 (1974) (no bibcode checked). No archived SVO VOTable was available for: I_ADPS, so those bands carry no per-band fields.
